# discord_server_member_permissions (Data Source)

Reads a member's server-level permissions as Discord computes them from all of the member's roles and `@everyone`. See [Get Guild Member Permissions](https://docs.discord.com/developers/resources/guild#get-guild-member-permissions).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_current_user" "bot" {}

data "discord_server_member_permissions" "bot" {
  server_id = var.server_id
  user_id   = data.discord_current_user.bot.id
}

check "bot_can_manage_roles" {
  assert {
    condition     = contains(data.discord_server_member_permissions.bot.permission_names, "MANAGE_ROLES")
    error_message = "The bot needs Manage Roles to manage discord_role resources."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).
- `user_id` (String) ID of the member's user.

### Read-Only

- `permission_names` (Set of String) Names of the permission flags set in `permissions`, such as `VIEW_CHANNEL`. Flags this provider does not know are omitted.
- `permissions` (String) The computed permissions as a decimal bitfield string.
